prompts.jatayu-sacrifice-reader: Landscape devotional painting: the aged vulture king Jatayu spreads his wings before Ravana's airborne golden chariot while Sita reaches toward her defender; non-graphic Dandaka forest sunset.

prompts.jatayu-sacrifice-card: Symbolic landscape still life: a large vulture feather, broken golden chariot wheel and snapped bow with forest flowers in dawn light; no people and no violence.
